messages:
maria: FYI seeing unexpected cross-workspace reads from a service account, noticed ~250 accesses from workspace-alpha -> secrets in workspace-beta in the audit stream.
maria: This started ~2026-03-18 22:03 UTC, right after the RBAC refactor rollout (deployer->workspace_deployer change).
aj: can you paste a few raw log lines? want to confirm principal and resource
maria: pasted sample below:
```
ts=2026-03-18T22:03:12Z action=read resource=workspace-beta/secrets/stripe_kv principal=serviceAccount:svc-deployer@workspace-alpha keystate=kms:projects/p-123/keys/wrk-beta-key
```
```
ts=2026-03-18T22:05:01Z action=list resource=workspace-beta/projects principal=serviceAccount:svc-deployer@workspace-alpha
```

sajal: that looks like a scope-evaluation bug — the policy engine seems to be matching `org_id` instead of `workspace_id` for that role after the refactor. i.e. we inadvertently made the check permissive when tenant_id was missing.
aj: could be the policy predicate: `allow if principal.workspace == resource.workspace || principal.org == resource.org` — if principal.workspace is null for the SA, the second clause makes it permissive.

irene: mitigation steps we should do now:
- rotate keys for svc-deployer (temporary): `rbacctl rotate-keys svc-deployer`
- revoke the deployer binding across non-prod workspaces: `rbacctl revoke --principal svc-deployer --scope workspace --except workspace-alpha`
- add a deny rule for cross-workspace reads: `policyctl add deny WHERE resource.scope==workspace AND principal.org==resource.org AND principal.workspace!=resource.workspace`

maria: done immediate revocation for beta and gamma; rotated keys. opened INC-2026-135 and linked logs. tagged infra+security.

deploy-bot: deploy job #4512 -> rolled back rbac-refactor v2 at 2026-03-18T22:18Z :rotating_light:

aj: good. we need a code patch to make the evaluator require explicit workspace match for workspace-scoped roles. sajal, can you own a minimal hotfix and unit tests? add an audit assertion that tenant_id is present for all SA principals.

sajal: on it. ETA 2h for PR, 6h for canary. will add an eval test that simulates missing workspace id and ensures deny.

maria: we should also check KMS grants — logs show `keystate=kms:projects/p-123/keys/wrk-beta-key`, verify the key grants don't have cross-workspace principals. added KMS audit task to INC-2026-135.

irene: operational note: notify any customers in workspace-beta if any secret reads were attempted. security will coordinate disclosure if needed. set severity SEV-3 for now until we confirm exfil.

maria: quick follow-ups: export full audit stream for 18:00-23:00 UTC to s3://redwood-incident-exports/inc-2026-135, retained for 30d. assigned sajal -> patch, aj -> postmortem, irene -> customer comms.

aj: adding acceptance criteria: (1) RBAC evaluator rejects SA without workspace_id for workspace-scoped roles, (2) automated alert on >10 cross-workspace reads by a single principal, (3) KMS grant review completed.

sajal: PR created: https://redwood/pulls/7890 , running unit and integration. will request review after green CI.

maria: thanks all. keep thread updates concise — add next steps to the incident ticket.
